title: 定义 2.9

source.quote: Definition 2.9. Let O^{⊗} be a small ∞-operad. We say O^{⊗} is coherent if it satisfies

conclusion: $\cO^{\otimes}$ 连贯，若 (i) unital；(ii) 颜色 $\infty$-范畴 $\cO$ 是空间；(iii) $\ev_{0}^{*}\colon(\Cat_{\infty})_{/\cO^{\otimes}}\to(\Cat_{\infty})_{/\cK_{\cO}}$ 有右伴随 $\ev_{0,*}$
label: L23-2.9
